name: 32-bit Tile-Depth Pair Sorting
definition: A sorting key format using 32-bit integers to replace 64-bit keys, optimizing for Vulkan sorting performance while maintaining quality.
summary: 32-bit Tile-Depth Pair Sorting compresses depth keys into 32 bits by packing resolution-adaptive tile IDs with quantized depth, reducing sorting traffic while maintaining quality comparable to 64-bit approaches.
